description:
An angel exiled to earth for spending one night with a devil. However... on earth, this devilish dog that I had raised turned out to be a real devil? 

And not just any devil, but the very same demon that corrupted me in the first place?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/3498023565), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/raised_the_devil), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11808358), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000065286)
